shared_elements: low-relief carved motifs on a large upright monolith
horizontal band/register division of the carved surface
schematic curved/hooked forms repeated in a row
justification: Both surfaces carry shallow, schematic relief organised into stacked horizontal registers of repeated small motifs, and both include rounded/disc-like and hooked curvilinear elements, which gives a loose formal echo. But what is depicted differs fundamentally: A is an anthropomorphic monument with a head, shoulders, a central disc on the chest and belt-like bands, whereas B shows rows of recognisable animals (birds and quadrupeds/serpentine creatures) in profile with no human body scheme.
